app_launches.label: Hint for apps
app_launches.description: Show the shortcut when you open an app from the launcher

workspace_switches.label: Hint for workspaces
workspace_switches.description: Show the shortcut when you switch workspace from the bar

suggest_after.label: Suggest a shortcut after (launches)
suggest_after.description: For apps without a shortcut, how many launches before saying so; 0 turns it off

suggest_period.label: Counted over
suggest_period.description: Only launches within this time count

ignore.label: Never show for
ignore.description: An app as named in the box, like Lutris, or a shortcut, like SUPER + 3. Capitals don't matter

notifications.label: Use notifications
notifications.description: Show hints as notifications instead of the box in the corner
